# Whole-diff review of the WebAC-comparison change (2026-10-13)

After implementation, one reviewer per lane read the lane diff with the item briefs and implementation reports, looking for logic bugs, unintended default visual changes, RynthSuite impact, unguarded wasm calls, flag discipline, dead code and cross-lane conflicts. Each finding was then re-verified against the current code by a fix agent (and, for most lanes, by an independent skeptic) and fixed when real. B-bridge-R1 (a doc sentence) and G-chargen-barber-R2 (plugin index) were fixed by the orchestrator.

Outcomes: fixed 42, fixed (orchestrator) 5 — every review finding resolved.
